span.p:
36 backend routes, 36 matched to a frontend hook.
0 unmatched frontend calls. 0 endpoints without a frontend caller.
Caveat: UpdateJob accepts a status field, but PostJobModal does not send it.
Prefix: routes/index.js mounts the API at process.env.BASE_URL (/api/v1).
Error responses per endpoint: see the sequence-*.puml diagrams.
